name: prumo-qa
description: Engenharia de qualidade local: contexto, contratos, MCP, evidências e aplicativo desktop Windows

scripts.build: node testes/apoio/dependencias.mjs && node frontend/construcao/sincronizar-frontend.mjs && node frontend/construcao/gerar-telas-modulares.mjs && node docs/geradores/catalogo-documentacao-viva.mjs && node site/release/limpar-compilados.mjs && tsc && node docs/geradores/gerar-mapa-do-aplicativo.mjs && node site/release/gerar-status.mjs && node site/release/build-broker.mjs
scripts.check: npm run dependencias && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.check:isolado: npm run dependencias && npm run typecheck && npm run build && node testes/apoio/executar.mjs --isolado
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --publish never
